title: Meter Operations Standard: The Standard Electricity Estimate and the Estimated Line Amount
content:
# The Standard Electricity Estimate — Utility Services Program

**Standard.** For an estimated electricity line of a Utility Services Program account, the standard estimate is the average electricity usage of the actual electricity reads dated fewer than four whole months before the billing date — their recorded usage summed and divided by their number — rounded to 3 decimals. Each sum of recorded electricity usage is taken to 2 decimals.

**Line.** The estimated electricity line bills the standard estimate as its usage, in kilowatt-hours to 3 decimals. Its usage charge is the billed estimated kilowatt-hours times the program's electricity rate per kWh, rounded half up to the cent once, at the end. Its electricity service charge is the program's monthly fixed electric service charge, rounded half up to the cent. The line's amount is its usage charge plus its electricity service charge, rounded half up to the cent.

## Inputs and their records

| Quantity | Record it comes from |
|---|---|
| actual electricity reads in the four-month window | the account's meter reads of electricity marked actual, dated fewer than four whole months before the billing date |
| electricity rate per kWh | the account's program |
| monthly fixed electric service charge | the account's program |

## Worked example (hypothetical reads, rate and charge)

Hypothetical inputs: three actual electricity reads in the four-month window recorded 540.00, 610.00 and 575.00 kWh; an electricity rate of $0.20 per kWh and a monthly electric service charge of $10.00 (illustrative figures, not the program's tariff).

- Sum of recorded usage: 1,725.00 kWh. Standard estimate: 1,725.00 divided by 3 is 575.000 kWh.
- Usage charge: 575.000 times $0.20 is $115.00.
- Amount: $115.00 plus $10.00 is $125.00.

*Rounding case (hypothetical):* reads of 500.00 and 501.00 kWh give a standard estimate of 500.500 kWh; at $0.1333 per kWh the product is $66.71665, which is $66.72 at the end.
